content.short: Unlimit is a global payments provider supporting cards, bank transfers, UPI and local methods.
content.description: Unlimit is a conventional global payment service provider covering cards, bank transfers and local methods such as UPI in India, with a crypto product line alongside. Established processors moving into crypto bring licensing and acquiring relationships that crypto-native onramps typically spend years assembling.
content.meta: An established global payment processor extending card and local rails into crypto.
